6. Malformed probe delays crash tests 📘 Rule violation ≡ Correctness
>
>Description >
> >
>slow_pause converts the external PROBE_DELAY environment value directly with float() instead
>of validating it through a Pydantic model. A nonnumeric or otherwise invalid delay reaches every
>patched Pilot.pause call and raises before the diagnostic test can complete.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[Docs/superpowers/qa/2026-09-18-mcp-inspector-guidance/current-dev/approved-closeout/tests/2722_click_probe.py[14]](https://github.com/rmusser01/tldw_chatbook/pull/2722/files#diff-fc9a2e8e45e64f70772d99888bf7e10ebeb7d385d54c74d1cbfaeb9f297e9d42R14-R14) > >```diff >+ await asyncio.sleep(float(os.environ.get('PROBE_DELAY','0'))) >``` >
>
>Relevance >
> > `●● Moderate` > >
>Validation concern is plausible, but requiring Pydantic for a simple probe delay is an architectural
>judgment.
>
> > ⓘ Recommendations generated based on similar findings in past PRs >
>
>Evidence >
> >
>Compliance rule 1011859 explicitly includes environment variables and requires loosely typed
>external data to be validated through a Pydantic model. The cited line reads PROBE_DELAY and
>immediately converts the raw value with float().

Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >The probe consumes an environment variable through a direct float conversion without Pydantic validation, allowing malformed values to abort every patched pause. > >## Fix Focus Areas >- Docs/superpowers/qa/2026-09-18-mcp-inspector-guidance/current-dev/approved-closeout/tests/2722_click_probe.py[12-14] > >## Recommended Fix >Define a small Pydantic settings or input model with a finite, nonnegative numeric delay field, validate `PROBE_DELAY` once when the fixture starts, and pass the validated value to `asyncio.sleep`. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >

Keep MCP inspector guidance scoped to server context 🐞 Bug fix 🧪 Tests 📝 Documentation 🕐 40+ Minutes
AI Description

>
>• Hide readiness badge, explanation, and actions whenever inspector details are open.
>• Preserve hidden guidance updates and restore current content after the final detail closes.
>• Stabilize Test Tool clicks and publish comprehensive native qualification evidence.
>
Diagram

```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor U as Detail Selection participant I as MCP Inspector participant O as Visibility Owner participant G as Guidance Block participant R as Readiness Refresh U->>I: Open detail I->>O: Sync visibility O->>G: Hide all guidance R->>I: Update readiness I-->>G: Refresh while hidden U->>I: Clear final detail I->>O: Sync visibility O->>G: Reveal current guidance ```
High-Level Assessment

>The PR's approach is appropriate: extend the established single visibility owner instead of adding per-view flags or changing routing. A dedicated wrapper widget could hide the three controls as one node, but it would require unnecessary composition and CSS changes for the same behavior.
